ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Retrieve_Data_Old IS
 edit_msg varchar2(405) := null;
 edit_msg2 varchar2(500) := null;
 accept boolean;
 cursor c1 is
 select line_text from bc_sp_ins
 where label_code = :ctrl_blk_1.inter_code
 order by line_number;
 TYPE attr IS TABLE OF varchar2(45)
 INDEX BY BINARY_INTEGER;
 var_attr attr;
 last_space number(3) := 0;
 line_counter number(3) := 0;
 cur_line_count number(3) := 0;
 last_line_end number(3) := 0;
 total_lines number(3) := 1;
 cur_char varchar2(1);
 ctr number(2) := 1;
BEGIN
 for rec in c1
 loop
 edit_msg := edit_msg || rec.line_text || chr(10);
 end loop; 
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.HELP_TEXT',visible,property_true);
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.HELP_TEXT2',visible,property_true);
 synchronize;
 show_editor('ATTRIB_EDITOR', edit_msg, 165, 100, edit_msg2, accept);
 IF length(edit_msg2) > 400 THEN
 --show_error_alert('Instructions too Long ... Not Saved');
 show_error('9801');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 if edit_msg2 is not null then
 for lenstr in 1.. length(edit_msg2)
 loop
 line_counter := line_counter + 1;
 cur_line_count := cur_line_count + 1;
 cur_char := substr(edit_msg2,lenstr,1);
 if cur_char = ' ' then
 last_space := cur_line_count;
 end if;

 if ascii(cur_char) = 10 then
 var_attr(total_lines):= substr(edit_msg2,last_line_end+1,cur_line_count-1);
 --message('1. ' ||to_char(total_lines) || ' ' || var_attr(total_lines));
 total_lines := total_lines + 1;
 cur_line_count := 0;
 last_line_end := lenstr;
 end if;
 if cur_line_count = 45 then
 var_attr(total_lines) := substr(edit_msg2,last_line_end, last_space);
 --message('2. ' || to_char(total_lines) || ' ' || var_attr(total_lines));
 total_lines := total_lines + 1;
 cur_line_count := cur_line_count - last_space+1;
 last_space := 0;
 last_line_end := lenstr - cur_line_count;
 end if;
 end loop;
 var_attr(total_lines) := substr(edit_msg2,last_line_end,cur_line_count-1);
 --message('3. ' || to_char(total_lines) || ' ' ||var_attr(total_lines));
 delete from bc_sp_ins 
 where label_code = :ctrl_blk_1.inter_code;
 for i in 1..total_lines
 loop
 var_attr(i) := rtrim(var_attr(i),chr(10));
 var_attr(i) := ltrim(var_attr(i),chr(10));
 var_attr(i) := rtrim(var_attr(i),' ');
 var_attr(i) := ltrim(var_attr(i),' ');
 if var_attr(i) is not null then
 insert into bc_sp_ins
 (label_code, line_number, line_text, 
 chapter_id, insert_user, insert_dats, 
 audit_key, program_id)
 values
 (:ctrl_blk_1.inter_code, ctr, var_attr(i),
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :BANNER.user_id, SYSDATE,
 NULL, :BANNER.prog_name);
 --message(var_attr(i));
 ctr := ctr + 1;
 end if;
 if ctr > 9 then
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 15;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 show_error('9163');
 end if; 
 execute_trigger('Key-clrfrm');
 check_package_failure;
 /*synchronize;*/
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DELETE_LINE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE delete_line IS
BEGIN
 DELETE_RECORD;
 LOOP
 :bc_sp_ins.line_number := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE' THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 
 IF :bc_sp_ins.line_number = 1 AND :bc_sp_ins.line_text IS NULL THEN -- IM 510
 DELETE_RECORD;
 END IF;
END delete_line;
